verdict.rationale: ClickUp's product page lists "Whiteboards" as one of its features, and the Figma integration supports embedding interactive prototypes for real-time design collaboration. However, the evidence is only a bare feature label with no detail on how the whiteboard works. Missing for 10: documentation of real-time multi-user whiteboard editing, visual tools on the canvas (shapes, sticky notes, connectors), sharing and permissions for whiteboards, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
